summary: Accept / core accept. Round 9 had no blockers, so previous_status is empty. The compatible dispositions preserve the accepted mechanisms and follow D14 both paths and D20–D22; native ISA 0.9 operations are not adopted. PT12 now explicitly propagates the full materialised update, including cmpxchg old/success results and selected stores. The gate rerun passed all 2834 rows. All 53 markers are present, but the 243 dependency references are not all valid or semantically appropriate against the ISA 0.8 target: four are 0.9-only IDs and several paragraph references have shifted meaning. Those are S1 annotation defects, not a demonstrated semantic divergence. The 33 open evidence closures are disclosed staging; neither the limited witnesses nor the green gate are treated as full end-to-end capability evidence. No new or regressed S0 issue, no spec-gap item, two suggestions.
